<!--
FDIC-BRC / JFQA revision, Phase 1.4 (plan i-am-planning-to-enchanted-codd.md).
§1 Overlay figure: uninsured vs insured time-deposit event studies in ONE panel.
§2 Balanced long event study: 2018Q1+ with binned endpoints (k clamped to
   [-20, +11]) so unbalanced-cohort edge quarters no longer produce the
   exploding k = -23..-21 / +12..+13 artifacts.
§3 Loan growth: 4-quarter event-time bins (ref [-4,-1]) replacing the noisy
   quarterly ES.
Panel: tracks/post-jmcb-rejection-june2026/data/panel_smallbank_20260612.rds
-->

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
source(here::here("tracks", "fdic-brc-jfqa-aug2026", "code", "_track_common.R"))

save_figures <- TRUE
save_tables  <- TRUE

panel <- readRDS(latest_track_file("panel_smallbank"))
setDT(panel)

dt_w <- panel[abs(qtrs_since) < 12]
dt_w[, D_DT := as.factor(D_DT)]
dt_w[, post := ifelse(qtrs_since > 0, 1, 0)]

setFixest_fml(
  ..controls  = ~ log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1,
  ..fe = ~ ID_RSSD + D_DT
)
```

## §1 Overlay composition figure

```{r}
m_u <- feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ i(qtrs_since, high_cecl_equity, ref = -1) +
               ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
m_i <- feols(ins_time_deps_assets ~ i(qtrs_since, high_cecl_equity, ref = -1) +
               ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)

pd_u <- extract_es_data(m_u)
pd_i <- extract_es_data(m_i)

p <- make_split_es_plot(
  pd_list = list(pd_u, pd_i),
  group_names = c("Uninsured time deposits", "Insured time deposits"),
  colors = c(primary_blue, primary_gold),
  title_str = "", ylab_str = "Coefficient (pp of assets)"
)
print(p)
save_track_fig(p, "fig_overlay_composition", width = 6.5, height = 4)
```

## §2 Balanced long event study (binned endpoints)

```{r}
dt_long <- panel[D_DT >= as.Date("2018-03-31")]
dt_long[, D_DT := as.factor(D_DT)]
dt_long[, k_bal := pmax(pmin(qtrs_since, 11L), -20L)]

cat("\n--- Balanced long ES: joint pre-trend tests (k in [-20,-2]) ---\n")
for (s in list(
  list(dv = "unins_time_deps_assets", stub = "fig_es_long_unins_balanced"),
  list(dv = "ins_time_deps_assets",   stub = "fig_es_long_ins_balanced")
)) {
  m <- feols(.[s$dv] ~ i(k_bal, high_cecl_equity, ref = -1) +
               ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_long, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
  w <- wald(m, keep = "k_bal::-", print = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("  %-30s F=%.3f  p=%.3f\n", s$stub, w$stat, w$p))
  p <- make_es_plot(m, ylab_str = "Coefficient", title_str = "",
                    event_var = "k_bal", vline_x = -1) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -12.5, xmax = -10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = accent_gray, alpha = 0.15) +
    annotate("text", x = -11.5, y = -Inf, label = "COVID", color = accent_gray,
             vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5)
  print(p)
  save_track_fig(p, s$stub, width = 6, height = 3)
}
cat("Endpoint bins: k = -20 pools all k <= -20; k = 11 pools all k >= 11.\n")
```

## §3 Loan growth, binned event time

```{r}
dt_w[, k_bin := cut(qtrs_since, breaks = c(-12, -8, -4, 0, 4, 8, 12),
                    right = FALSE, labels = c("[-12,-9]", "[-8,-5]", "[-4,-1]",
                                              "[0,3]", "[4,7]", "[8,11]"))]
m_lg <- feols(loan_growth ~ i(k_bin, high_cecl_equity, ref = "[-4,-1]") +
                ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
print(etable(m_lg, dict = covariate_labels_dict))

cf <- coef(m_lg); sev <- se(m_lg)
idx <- grepl("^k_bin::", names(cf))
pd <- data.table(
  bin = sub("^k_bin::(.*):high_cecl_equity$", "\\1", names(cf)[idx]),
  est = cf[idx], se = sev[idx]
)
pd <- rbind(pd, data.table(bin = "[-4,-1]", est = 0, se = 0))
pd[, bin := factor(bin, levels = c("[-12,-9]", "[-8,-5]", "[-4,-1]",
                                   "[0,3]", "[4,7]", "[8,11]"))]
setorder(pd, bin)
pd[, `:=`(lo90 = est - CI_Z * se, hi90 = est + CI_Z * se)]

# Integer x positions: mixing a discrete factor axis with numeric annotate()/
# vline() coordinates errors at render time (blank PNG).
pd[, x := as.integer(bin)]
p <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = x, y = est)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = accent_gray, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, color = "darkred", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = 3.6, y = Inf, label = "CECL Adoption",
           color = accent_gray, vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0, size = 2.8) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo90, ymax = hi90), color = primary_blue,
                  linewidth = 0.7, size = 0.45) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pd$x, labels = levels(pd$bin)) +
  theme_custom() +
  labs(x = "Quarters relative to CECL adoption (4-quarter bins)",
       y = "Coefficient (quarterly loan growth, %)")
print(p)
save_track_fig(p, "fig_es_loan_growth_binned", width = 6, height = 3)

cat("\n================ DIAGNOSTICS ================\n")
cat("dt_w rows:", nrow(dt_w), "| dt_long rows:", nrow(dt_long), "\n")
cat("Loan-growth bin estimates:\n"); print(pd)
```
